title: Data Analyst
text:
Ryanair, over our 40 year history has grown to become Europe’s largest airline group connecting more guests across more routes than any other European carrier. We are a fast-paced, ambitious and innovative company, offering exciting career opportunities across aviation, technology, operations and support functions. Now is a fantastic time to join as we look to grow to over 800 aircraft and 300m guests within the next 8 years.

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team in Wroclaw, Poland. In this role, you will convert raw data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong organisational capabilities, technical proficiency, and a commitment to identifying significant patterns within complex datasets.



- Collect, cleanse, and process data from multiple sources to maintain accuracy and consistency standards
- Analyse complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies that inform business strategy
- Design and monitor A/B testing frameworks for experiments across multiple business domains
- Conduct statistical analysis and develop models to support forecasting and predictive analytics
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams across business, finance, and operations to establish data requirements and deliver tailored analytical solutions
- Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Develop AI agents to enhance the efficiency of current business processes
- Utilise Google Cloud Platform for commercial insights analysis and reporting
- Proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating databases
- Strong experience with Power BI
- Demonstrated expertise in Excel, including advanced functions and pivot tables
- Experience with statistical analysis and data modeling techniques
- Proficiency in Python 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
- Excellent organizational and time management abilities
- Proven ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously
- Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders
- Experience with data warehousing concepts and ETL processes (preferred)
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment

Benefits And Types Of Contract

Contract of employment (permanent contract after trial period)



- Possible hybrid model (2 days from the office weekly)
- Staff travel benefits from day one
- Creative work tax deduction
- Multisport card
- Private health care
- Group insurance scheme

Other Benefits



- Great chance to meet your colleagues in other offices
- Option to participate in trainings and conferences
- Annual events (i.e. St. Patrick’s Day 🍀)
- Regular social meetings 🍻
- Paid referral system
- New office building surrounded by great dinettes right in the city centre 🌆

Apply today to discuss the role in more detail!

title: Software Engineer (AxiomSL AI)
text:
As a Software Engineer reporting to the VP, Product Management, you'll play a critical role in designing and delivering sophisticated software solutions that power Nasdaq's AxiomSL AI product. You'll work across the full development lifecycle, from architecture to implementation, bringing your expertise to a fast-growing, innovation-driven team.

You'll thrive in this position if you're a problem-solver who enjoys tackling complex technical challenges, collaborating across functions, and helping those around you grow.

Please note: This is an urgent hiring requirement, and we are seeking a candidate who can join the team no later than 1 October 2026. Candidates with immediate availability or short notice periods are strongly encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities



- Design, develop, and implement scalable software solutions across new and existing applications and systems architecture.
- Lead technical analysis of complex assignments, including coding, testing, debugging, and delivering robust outcomes.
- Drive security-conscious development practices and ensure cross-platform compatibility across products.
- Build reliable integrations between AI services, structured data sources, and enterprise platform components.
- Mentor team members, championing best practices and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and efficiency.

Required Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Strong software development experience, including Python, for building scalable backend services, integrations, and data-driven applications, with strong SQL skills for working with structured enterprise data.
- Experience building and integrating APIs, services, or platform components within enterprise application environments, including data pipelines, transformation, and validation.
- Experience working on AI/ML-enabled products or platform capabilities, including integrating or delivering AI-driven solutions in production or near-production environments.
- Clear communicator with proven ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and client-facing teams in fast-paced, matrixed environments.

Preferred Qualifications



- Master's degree in a specialized area such as financial markets, mathematics, or computer science.
- Experience in fintech, capital markets, or regulated technology environments.
- Familiarity with emerging AI technologies and their application within enterprise software platforms.

Location

This position is located in Wrocław, Poland and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment, with at least 3 days per week in-office.

For more information, visit Nasdaq Benefits & Rewards Career Page.

Come as You Are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

Benefits & Rewards

We offer a competitive, well-rounded rewards package that supports you and your family - inside and outside work.

The annual gross base pay for this role is zł135,000 - zł263,000. At Nasdaq, we use a structured job and career framework to make sure growth opportunities are clear and fair. The pay range you see reflects the full salary band for this job level, including room for progression over time. The actual offer will depend on factors like your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will fall within a portion of the posted range that’s appropriate for this role. In addition to base pay, we offer short-term incentives (bonus or commission) and long-term incentives (equity), where applicable, as well as the following benefits:

Pathway is shaking the foundations of artificial intelligence by introducing the world's first post-transformer model that adapts and thinks just like humans.

Pathway's breakthrough architecture (BDH) outperforms Transformer and provides the enterprise with full visibility into how the model works. Combining the foundational model with the fastest data processing engine on the market, Pathway enables enterprises to move beyond incremental optimization and toward truly contextualized, experience-driven intelligence. Pathway is led by co-founder & CEO Zuzanna Stamirowska, a complexity scientist who created a team consisting of AI pioneers, including CTO Jan Chorowski who was the first person to apply Attention to speech and worked with Nobel laureate Goeff Hinton at Google Brain, as well as CSO Adrian Kosowski, a leading computer scientist and quantum physicist who obtained his PhD at the age of 20.

- Programming skills in Python (with exposure to ML libraries like TensorFlow, PyTorch)
- Experience with cluster, systems, and networks administration
- Willingness to learn

This position holds a minimum requirement of a BSc in Computer Science or Information Technology.

text:
Job Description

Automation Engineer / Inżynier Automatyk (f/m/x)

rola dzienna z elastycznym czasem pracy

w Mars Petcare, Sochaczew

Fabryka Mars Petcare w Sochaczewie to jeden z kluczowych zakładów produkcyjnych Mars w Europie, wykorzystujący nowoczesne linie technologiczne oraz zaawansowane systemy automatyki przemysłowej. W związku z ciągłym rozwojem zakładu oraz realizacją projektów inwestycyjnych i modernizacyjnych poszukujemy osoby, która wesprze rozwój i niezawodność naszych systemów sterowania.

Jako Inżynier Automatyk / Inżynierka Automatyk będziesz pełnić rolę eksperta technicznego w obszarze automatyki. Jest to stanowisko w systemie dziennym, skoncentrowane przede wszystkim na realizacji projektów modernizacyjnych, optymalizacji istniejących rozwiązań oraz zapewnianiu długoterminowej niezawodności systemów sterowania. Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z zespołem Utrzymania Ruchu, wspierając go w analizie i rozwiązywaniu bardziej złożonych problemów technicznych oraz wdrażając działania zapobiegające powstawaniu awarii. To rola dla osoby, która lubi łączyć wiedzę techniczną z pracą projektową i chce mieć realny wpływ na rozwój nowoczesnego środowiska produkcyjnego.

Jakie będą Twoje główne obowiązki?



- Nadzór nad eksploatacją infrastruktury sterującej oraz systemów automatyki w powierzonym obszarze produkcyjnym.
- Inicjowanie, prowadzenie oraz wdrażanie projektów modernizacyjnych związanych z automatyką, systemami sterowania i cyfryzacją procesów produkcyjnych.
- Wspieranie zespołu Utrzymania Ruchu w analizie przyczyn źródłowych awarii oraz rozwiązywaniu złożonych problemów technicznych związanych z automatyką.
- Organizowanie i koordynowanie prac przeglądowych, serwisowych i remontowych realizowanych przez techników utrzymania ruchu oraz firmy zewnętrzne.
- Zarządzanie kopiami zapasowymi systemów sterowania oraz nadzór nad narzędziami służącymi do archiwizacji i odtwarzania programów sterowników.
- Zapewnianie dostępności narzędzi niezbędnych do diagnostyki systemów automatyki, takich jak programatory, mierniki czy narzędzia konfiguracyjne.
- Wdrażanie rozwiązań zwiększających niezawodność maszyn i urządzeń poprzez monitorowanie parametrów procesowych, analizę trendów oraz identyfikowanie potencjalnych ryzyk.
- Opracowywanie i wdrażanie działań prewencyjnych mających na celu ograniczanie liczby awarii i przestojów produkcyjnych.
- Szkolenie Współpracowników w zakresie przeprowadzania działań prewencyjnych oraz tworzenie materiałów szkoleniowych dla Współpracowników (elektryków i techników Utrzymania Ruchu).

- Udział w definiowaniu standardów technicznych oraz najlepszych praktyk związanych z automatyką przemysłową.

- Praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z systemami automatyki przemysłowej oraz sterownikami PLC.

title: Asset Analytics Engineer

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Your role

As an Asset Analytics Engineer with a focus on Smart Signal and Predictive Modelling, you will take ownership of the end-to-end technical deployment of predictive models across industrial asset fleets. Leveraging platforms such as SmartSignal (GE Vernova), Aspen Mtell, or AVEVA PRiSM, you will transform raw historian data into high-fidelity digital twins that power reliability decisions.

Your tasks




- Performing complex tag mapping of historian data sources (PI, OPC, IP21) to the SmartSignal Standard Data Model, ensuring data lineage, quality, and consistency across fleet-level deployment
- Applying Similarity-Based Modelling (SBM) and Empirical Model Learning (EML) techniques to establish accurate 'Normal' operating profiles, selecting Gold Standard training windows that represent healthy asset state
- Developing and maintaining Analytic Blueprints - reusable templates for common industrial asset classes such as pumps, motors, and transformers - to enable rapid and scalable deployment

Your profile 




- 5+ years of experience in data analytics, reliability engineering, or a related field, with hands-on experience on platforms such as SmartSignal, Aspen Mtell, or AVEVA PRiSM, including Blueprint and model review workflows
- Strong Python proficiency (Pandas, NumPy) for data manipulation and custom analytics development, combined with solid SQL skills for querying CMMS systems (Maximo, SAP PM) and Historian database
- Demonstrated experience with industrial data systems including PI, OPC, and IP21 historians, and familiarity with API data extraction tools such as Postman or equivalent
- A structured, detail-oriented approach to data quality and model governance, with the ability to manage model lifecycle activities including training, tuning, retraining, and performance monitoring across large asset fleets

title: Software Engineer Agentic AI Platform
text:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a Flex Work approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.

About The Role

We're building Dolby's Centralized Agentic AI Framework — a shared platform that brings safe, governed, cost-aware AI agents into every team's GitLab workflow.

You'll be a hands-on engineer building and extending this platform — writing the Lambdas that orchestrate agents, integrating Bedrock with GitLab CI, hardening the security and observability layers, and shipping new agent capabilities that any team can adopt without re-architecting.

What You'll Do



- Build agent orchestration — implement Router Lambdas, SQS-based queueing, and Bedrock Agent invocation 
- Integrate with GitLab CI/CD — design .gitlab-ci.yml patterns where agent invocations run as pipeline stages, consume branch/diff/test context, emit artefacts, and gate downstream stages on agent pass/fail signals.
- Develop shared Action Groups — build the AWS Lambda-backed tools 
- Design Knowledge Bases — iUtilise AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base / OpenSearch / S3 so agents reason over shared organizational context, not isolated prompts.
- Implement Bedrock Guardrails — input/output filters, sensitive-data scrubbing, content/word filters, and per-agent permission boundaries enforced by design.
- Implement TokenOps controls — model tiering and routing via an LLM gateway, semantic caching, context-window management
- Instrument everything in AWS — CloudWatch dashboards, audit trails, trace logging of every agent invocation (input, output, decision, tokens, cost) for compliance and debugging.

Required (3–5 Years Professional Experience)



- Strong Python, AWS SDK Python for building production Lambda functions and event-driven services.
- Solid AWS experience: Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch. 
- Amazon Bedrock specifically: Agents, Action Groups, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails.
- Hands-on experience integrating with LLM APIs — Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar. 
- Familiarity with CI/CD platforms — GitLab CI strongly 
- A security mindset: least-privilege IAM, secrets handling, input validation, awareness of prompt injection and data-leak risks in LLM workflows.
- Comfortable with observability — structured logging, metrics, tracing — and writing code that's debuggable in production.

Nice to have



- Experience with SAST/DAST/SCA tools
- Experience building developer platforms or internal tooling — you've shipped something other engineers depend on daily.
- Familiarity with agent frameworks (Bedrock AgentCore) and their tradeoffs.

How You Work



- You write small, focused services with clear contracts — not monoliths.
- You treat extensibility as a feature: new triggers/agents/tools shouldn't require touching unrelated layers.
- You think about the developer experience of the teams who'll use your platform, not just whether the code runs.
- You're comfortable with ambiguity — agentic systems are non-deterministic, and you debug them empirically.

In this position...

Join our dynamic and agile team pioneering Ford's EV future. As a Mechanical Design Engineer for Thermal Systems, you will own the physical design of thermal hardware across the entire system — coolant loops, refrigeration/heat-pump circuits, and HVAC/climate — turning thermal performance targets into robust, manufacturable components and assemblies. You will help design and package hardware that keep the battery, drive units, power electronics, and cabin within their thermal limits all the way from concept through production release.

What you'll do...

You will lead the mechanical design of thermal system hardware across one or more subsystems, translating performance and packaging requirements into detailed, manufacturable designs.

Component & Assembly Design: Design thermal hardware across coolant, refrigeration, and HVAC/climate subsystems in 3D CAD from concept through production release.

System Packaging & Routing: Package and route thermal hardware through the vehicle, resolving space, interface, and clearance constraints with adjacent systems (battery, drive unit, power electronics, IP, chassis, and body) and coordinating shared interfaces across subsystems.

Performance-Driven Design: Translate thermal, hydraulic, and refrigerant performance targets from the system and subsystem engineers into physical geometry — flow paths, sealing, mounting, and heat-exchanger placement — that meets thermal, pressure, and flow requirements.

Design for Manufacture & Assembly (DFM/DFA): Develop designs optimized for their manufacturing processes (injection molding, brazing, stamping, extrusion, machining) and for high-volume assembly, working with full service and build to print suppliers on tooling and process feasibility to balance cost, mass, and quality.

Tolerance & GD&T: Apply geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, perform tolerance stack-up analysis, and define critical dimensions to ensure fit, sealing, and function across the production range and across mating subsystems.

Design Analysis & Robustness: Support structural, flow, thermal, and durability analysis (CFD/FEA in partnership with analysis teams), and use DFMEA to identify and mitigate various failure modes.

Engineering Documentation: Create and release detailed part and assembly drawings, manage engineering changes, and maintain CAD data and bills of materials through the product development process.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the system and subsystem engineers (who own performance targets), Controls Engineers (for actuator/valve strategy), test engineers (for validation), and suppliers (for tooling and build), supporting design reviews and readiness gates through launch.

You'll have...

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

3+ years of experience in mechanical design of automotive components or systems.

Proficiency in 3D CAD (CATIA, NX, or 3DEXPERIENCE) for part and assembly modeling and detailing.

Working knowledge of GD&am

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. Key Job Responsibilities

Take innovation from idea to implementation

We are looking for a Motor & Pumps Engineer with a strong electrical background to join an international product development environment, characterized by close collaboration with global suppliers and cross-functional teams.

What you'll do:

In your role you will support design and development of motors and pumps for household appliances such as washing machines, tumble dryers and dishwashers, including both existing products and new introductions,

You will contribute to the development, validation, and industrialization phases, working in compliance with established company processes, procedures, and standards.

- Manage approval documentation including drawings (collection, analysis and issuing via PLM software)

Where you'll be:

You will be based in our R&D Tech & Labs offices, located in Zarow, our dishwasher manufacturing plant. In our office, you will work together with hundreds of people from different functions and various nationalities, with the common goal of creating the technologies of the future.

title: Mechatronics System Designer
text:
Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility?

Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere.

Responsibilities



-  Identify and evaluate new technologies, components and suppliers to support future product development and innovation. 
-  Define technical requirements and ensure components meet performance, quality, reliability and cost targets. 
-  Lead component development activities from concept and feasibility phases through testing, validation and industrialization. 
-  Collaborate closely with suppliers to develop, improve and optimize products throughout their lifecycle. 
-  Analyze test results and technical data to ensure solutions perform as expected in real-life operating conditions. 
-  Support the introduction of new products and technologies into serial production, ensuring a smooth transition from development to manufacturing. 
-  Manage technical risks, identify improvement opportunities and contribute to continuous product optimization. 
-  Act as a technical reference for mechatronic components, sharing knowledge and supporting global project teams. 

Profile



-  Engineering degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering or similar. 
-  Experience in automotive R&D, product development or systems engineering. 
-  Strong understanding of complex technical products and multidisciplinary development environments. 
-  Knowledge of product validation and engineering best practices. 
-  Ability to coordinate stakeholders and drive technical topics independently. 
-  Proactive mindset and strong problem-solving approach. 
-  Fluent English. 

Benefits



-  Co-financing of private medical care and life insurance with a capital fund. 
-  Subsidized sports cards. 
-  Support for language courses and meal subsidies. 
-  Extra paid day off in your birthday month. 
-  Free on-site parking. 

At OPmobility, people truly matter. We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly - because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward.

Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work. You’ll grow in an international environment where cutting-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow’s automotive industry.

Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions.

With €11.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R&D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact. All driven by a shared ambition to accelerate the automotive energy transition.

title: Junior Test Automation Engineer

Dzięki naszemu zaangażowaniu klienci mogą mieć pewność, że ich produkty są nie tylko funkcjonalne, ale również stabilne, bezpieczne i dopasowane do potrzeb biznesowych.

Poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Junior Test Automation Engineer, która dołączy do naszego zespołu testerów automatyzujących i będzie rozwijać swoje umiejętności w obszarze automatyzacji testów. Nie wymagamy komercyjnego doświadczenia w automatyzacji testów. Oczekujemy natomiast podstawowej wiedzy z zakresu testowania oprogramowania, podstaw programowania oraz umiejętności tworzenia prostych testów automatycznych w Javie lub TypeScript.

Szukamy osoby zmotywowanej do rozwoju w kierunku automatyzacji testów i systematycznego poszerzania swoich umiejętności technicznych.

Wymagania



- Podstawy programowania (Java lub TypeScript)

- Rozumienie podstaw testów

- Mile widziana znajomość SQL

title: Otwarta Rekrutacja Arcadis (rocketjobs.pl)
text:
Arcadis zaprasza do współpracy osoby zaangażowane i z pozytywnym nastawieniem, które chcą wziąć udział w dużych, skomplikowanych projektach wielobranżowych z zakresu infrastruktury drogowej, kolejowej, budownictwa kubaturowego oraz hydrotechniki. Jeżeli chcesz się rozwijać, zdobywać nowe doświadczenie, pracować przy najtrudniejszych projektach w Polsce i na świecie, dołącz do nas i aplikuj.

W Arcadis koncentrujemy się na zatrudnieniu, angażowaniu i rozwoju osób, które podzielają naszą pasję i chęć poprawy jakości życia dla wszystkich ludzi na całym świecie. W ramach współpracy z ARCADIS będziesz miał okazję kształtować zarówno swoje najbliższe otoczenie, jak i cały świat.

Współpracując z nami, będziesz miał widoczny wpływ na rozwój naszej planety, co będzie możliwe między innymi poprzez współpracę z klientami, rozwijanie swoich umiejętności, walkę o równość lub działalność charytatywną – opcje są nieograniczone. Nasi pracownicy cenią różne perspektywy, dbają o zrównoważony rozwój naszej planety i mają odwagę kształtować nową, lepszą przyszłość.

Jedną z najważniejszych wartości ARCADIS jest rozwój naszych pracowników. Z pomocą fundacji Loovinklaan, inwestujemy w rozwój Arcadian, by w pełni wykorzystać ich potencjał.

Będziesz miał możliwość nawigować swoją karierą, uczestnicząc w międzynarodowych projektach branżowych i znajdując rozwiązania, które w przyszłości ułatwią ludziom życie.

title: Structural Modelling Engineer M/F
text:
We are looking for a Structural Modelling Engineer to join our CAE & Advanced Methods team in our Verkor Innovation Center (Grenoble, France).

As such, you develop, validate, and deploy structural modeling capabilities for Li-ion battery cells, module and pack assemblies, and their components. You contribute to robust product design decisions by delivering reliable finite-element and surrogate models, correlating simulations with physical tests, and supporting design optimization throughout the product development lifecycle.

Main responsibilities :



- Develop structural finite-element models for Li-ion battery cells, module and pack assemblies, and associated components
- Perform meshing on complex 3D CAD designs and run structural and thermo-mechanical simulations under static and dynamic events such as shock, vibration, crash and durability
- Build surrogate models and reduced-order models from full-order finite-element models to accelerate design exploration
- Validate simulation models against physical test results and document correlation assumptions, limitations, and confidence levels
- Construct analysis workflows with product design engineers to support thermo-mechanical design optimization from early concept phases through the product lifecycle
- Develop physical test and simulation methods for mechanical characterization of cells, modules, and components, including material model identification
- Review scientific and technical literature to identify state-of-the-art methods for modeling, characterization, and structural or thermo-mechanical analysis
- Collaborate with product development leaders to deliver simulation case studies in line with project priorities and timelines
- Lead technical investigations, perform diagnostic analyses, prepare progress updates, and contribute to design review dossiers
- Contribute to intellectual property development by identifying and documenting innovative modeling methods, workflows, or design insights


Requirements :



- Master’s degree or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, or a closely related discipline
- Specialized knowledge in structural mechanics, strength of materials, thermal engineering, and thermo-mechanical behavior
- 10+ years of experience preferred in structural and thermal modeling, finite-element analysis, and model validation
- Proficiency in CAD, meshing, mathematical modeling, numerical methods, and model order reduction techniques
- Proficiency in scientific coding, preferably Python and/or Matlab
- Experience with simulation tools such as 3DEXPERIENCE, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, or equivalent platforms
- Experience in, and aptitude for, hands-on laboratory activities and physical test interpretation
- Project management experience; English proficiency required; French is a plus

title: Commissioning Engineer
text:
Join us and take your career to the next level

Are you looking for new challenges in automation, electrical engineering, and machine building? Join our Final Assembly (FAS) team as a Commissioning Engineer. You will be responsible for commissioning and testing advanced machinery at our facility and leading field projects for clients worldwide.

- Commissioning & Testing: Conduct machine testing and commissioning in the factory and during final assembly at customer sites.

- Education: Higher technical degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, or related fields.

title: Control Logic and PLC Debugger
text:
We are looking for a 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹 𝗟𝗼𝗴𝗶𝗰 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗣𝗟𝗖 𝗗𝗲𝗯𝘂𝗴𝗴𝗲𝗿. You'll build control logic debugging tasks around an automated machine, line or process cell you have worked on, so a leading AI company can measure how well models handle real embedded engineering problems.


𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘀:

- Location: Poland
- Working model: Hybrid
- Start date: ASAP
- Employment type: Freelance – hourly rate: $70–90 (paid per accepted task)


𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:

- Build a benchmark environment around an automated machine, line or process cell you have worked on
- Include the PLC program in ladder, structured text or function blocks (IEC 61131-3 or similar), the I/O map, device and drive datasheets, the sequence and interlock specification, alarm and event logs, and a simulator or test harness for the process
- Set up the tools the work needs – an IEC 61131-3 runtime or compiler such as OpenPLC or MATIEC, the process simulator, Python, PDF tools
- Write five or more tasks, each built on a sequence, interlock or recipe fault on that cell (e.g. a sequence that stalls when one sensor responds late, an interlock that can be bypassed on restart, a recipe change that breaks a dosing step)
- Frame each task so the model must work through the program and logs, change the logic, run it against the simulator, and deliver the patched program plus answer.json naming the change
- Write a hidden marking script that runs the patched program through the normal sequence and hidden fault scenarios – a late sensor, a drive trip, power loss mid-cycle, an operator restart – scoring 0.0 to 1.0 by the share that end in a safe and correct state
- Design tasks where the naive fix passes the normal sequence but fails a fault path
- Supply your own answer (scoring 1.0) and a naive answer a competent engineer might give first (scoring below 0.3)


𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀:

- Hands-on controls engineering experience on an automated machine, line or process cell
- Strong PLC programming skills in ladder, structured text or function blocks (IEC 61131-3 or similar)
- Experience designing and debugging sequences, interlocks and recipes
- Able to work from I/O maps, device and drive datasheets, and sequence and interlock specifications
- Experience diagnosing faults from alarm and event logs
- Comfortable with IEC 61131-3 runtimes or compilers such as OpenPLC or MATIEC, and process simulators or test harnesses
- Python skills to write automated marking scripts


𝗡𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗽𝘀:

- Press "Apply"
- We will review your application
- If qualified, you will be accepted into the network and can be considered for this and similar positions & projects


We can only accept candidates that are willing to work as individual contractors / freelancers.

title: Inżynier Algorytmów Sterowania (głowice obserwacyjne) [K/M]
text:
Flytronic S.A. (część Grupy WB) to polska firma założona w 2008 roku. Specjalizujemy się w projektowaniu i produkcji bezzałogowych statków powietrznych, wykorzystywanych głównie w sektorze militarnym. Nasze kompetencje obejmują rozwój systemów elektronicznych, informatycznych oraz konstrukcji mechanicznych (lotniczych). Tworzymy zaawansowane technologie w zakresie bezzałogowych platform latających, systemów kontroli i sterowania lotem, transmisji danych oraz głowic obserwacyjnych.


Wraz z rozwojem Pionu Badawczo-Rozwojowego do Działu Rozwoju Oprogramowania poszukujemy aktualnie Inżyniera Algorytmów Sterowania. Osoba ta będzie zajmowała się implementacją algorytmów sterowania dla głowic obserwacyjnych stosowanych w systemach bezzałogowych (UAV/drony).


Typowy zakres obowiązków na tym stanowisku to:

- Projektowanie algorytmów sterowania głowicą obserwacyjną (stabilizacja, kompensacja drgań, sterowanie silnikami BLDC).
- Implementacja, testowanie i optymalizacja algorytmów na platformach docelowych (np. ARM).
- Tworzenie i rozwój algorytmów DSP: filtracja, estymacja, synchronizacja, kompensacje i korekcje.
- Przetwarzanie i analiza danych z czujników (żyroskop, akcelerometr, magnetometr, enkoder; łączenie danych z wielu źródeł).
- Współpraca z zespołami integracji, mechaniki i elektroniki w celu zapewnienia spójnego działania całego układu.
- Udział w testach laboratoryjnych i poligonowych (SIL/HIL, testy terenowe) oraz analiza wyników.
- Przygotowywanie dokumentacji technicznej i raportów z badań.


Wymagania:

- Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne (automatyka/robotyka, elektronika, informatyka lub pokrewne).
- Doświadczenie w projektowaniu algorytmów sterowania (np. PID, modelowanie dynamiki, sterowanie adaptacyjne, śledzenie trajektorii, pętle sprzężenia zwrotnego).
- Znajomość technik cyfrowego przetwarzania sygnałów (filtracja, analiza czasowo-częstotliwościowa, estymacja stanu).
- Praktyczna znajomość C/C++ i Pythona (co najmniej poziom umożliwiający implementację i prototypowanie algorytmów).
- Umiejętność modelowania i symulacji (np. testy numeryczne, walidacja modeli, strojenie regulatorów).


Mile widziane:

- Doświadczenie z narzędziami do symulacji i analizy (Matlab/Simulink, SciPy).
- Znajomość metod fuzji sensorycznej i filtrów Kalmana (EKF/UKF, AHRS/INS) i pracy z czujnikami IMU i enkoderami.
- Praktyka w systemach wbudowanych i niskiej latencji (Embedded Systems, RTOS, DMA, praca w ograniczeniach pamięci/opóźnień).
- Doświadczenie z głowicami obserwacyjnymi, gimbalami lub innymi precyzyjnymi układami napędowymi.
- Znajomość narzędzi CI/CD, testów jednostkowych/integracyjnych (np. GoogleTest/PyTest) i pracy z Git.


Co oferujemy:

title: Data Scientists / ML Engineers
text:
Coface DataLab is recruiting junior and senior data scientists/ ML engineers to develop and deliver operational AI/ machine learning solutions for the company.


With a presence in around 100 countries, Coface is a leading global player in credit insurance and risk management. Coface is also a recognized expert in business information, surety bonds, political risk, debt collection, and factoring. We help our clients secure their business activities to build more successful companies.


Directly sponsored by several members of the Group Executive Committee, the Data Lab brings together expertise in Data Science and Software Engineering to design, develop, and deploy operational solutions that improve the company's risk management, business processes, products and services. The steadily growing team now has around 30 members, mainly based in Paris, as well as in Toronto and Casablanca.



Job Description


The team addresses many use cases for Data Science, involving a variety of Machine Learning and AI technologies. For example:



- Scoring the risk of business failure with Machine Learning models
- Extracting information from images and documents with Transformers and LLMs
- Identifying companies with a custom search engine using embeddings
- Building and mining knowledge graphs
- Financial modeling and simulations
The Data Lab's work includes solid Software Engineering practices to achieve operational integrations in internal tools and client applications. Data Lab’s developments also include data extractions from the company’s databases and management of CI/CD pipelines to deploy applications and APIs on Docker/Kubernetes infrastructures, Apache Airflow, and in the cloud.


Knowledge sharing through presentations between team members, training, and technology monitoring during dedicated time are all part of how the Data Lab operates.


Your missions:



- You join Data Lab team and most often work in pairs or small teams on innovative projects.
- You design and develop complete solutions, from data extraction and modeling to deployment on our container infrastructures or in the cloud, and monitoring in production
- You contribute to technology monitoring and knowledge sharing within the team
 


 



Qualifications


The profiles we are looking for:



- Engineering degree or equivalent in Data Science
- 3 years of experience demostrating proficiency in Python and best practices for code review and continuous integration
- Use of Linux and Git
- Autonomy, curiosity, rigor
- English and French are mandatory: interactions with business teams all around the world
Recruitment process:



- Technical interview (video), including a review of the candidate's professional background — estimated duration: 1 hour
- Technical assessment in Python and Machine Learning, without AI coding assistance — two Colab notebooks, approximately 45 minutes each
- Interview with the human resources department — estimated duration: 45 minutes
- Job offer

Additional Information


Hybrid position


Remote Work Benefits

All our employees benefit from 3 days of remote work per week and a maximum monthly subsidy of €30. Employees receive vouchers worth €12 for each day of remote work.


Language Training

Depending on the type of employment contract, Coface provides employees with access to an e-learning platform dedicated to learning 6 foreign languages.


Remote Work Equipment

An equipment allowance of €350 for remote work is available to employees, depending on the type of employment contract.


Electric Bike Purchase

A contribution towards the purchase of an electric bike is available to employees, depending on the type of employment contract.

We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from our office in Bucharest.

Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products.

We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.

For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?

The mission

As an engineer in the AI Chapter, you will be part of the Wholesale Banking Lending Tech organization. The AI Chapter focuses on delivering AI-driven capabilities across Lending, including data extraction, AIOps, and intelligent automation.

The chapter works closely with engineering squads, data teams, and business stakeholders to develop and scale AI use cases that improve efficiency, risk management, and decision-making. You will contribute to multiple initiatives within the AI portfolio, gaining exposure to different use cases and technologies.

Your day to day

- Develop and scale AI/GenAI and machine learning use cases in the Lending domain
- Translate business problems into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions

- Collaborate with engineering teams and business stakeholders across multiple squads
- Contribute to automation, data extraction, and intelligent decision-support solutions
- Support end-to-end delivery including prototyping, testing, deployment, and documentation

What You'll Bring To The Team

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals and a growth mindset:



- Strong programming skills in Python (Java is a plus)
- Knowledge of machine learning, NLP, or LLM-based solutions
- Experience with modern AI tooling (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face)
- Familiarity with APIs and software engineering best practices
- Understanding of CI/CD, software lifecycle, and cloud platforms (GCP/AWS/Azure)

title: Hypersonic Design Engineer
text:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

Collaboration with multidisciplinary set of engineers to design and analyze mechanical components and systems for experimental Hypersonic, aero-thermal test rigs. To accomplish the given tasks, you must be proficient in developing mechanical designs using CAD and applying engineering principles to analyze the integrity and/or performance of the designed components and subsystems. You should have an excellent understanding of the engineering process, leading proof-of-concept ideas towards validated solutions. Communication and documentation are critical as you will often need to prepare slides (or other documents) to present to the team, whether it is to describe detailed designs or to discuss project progress.

Roles And Responsibilities



- Execute the design, analysis and evaluation of assigned projects using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, procedures and program / product requirements.
- Cross functional knowledge of high-speed fluid dynamic, mechanical systems and thermal response and application to rapid development of prototype hypersonic propulsion systems
- Develop mechanical systems from proof-of-concept to final manufacturable component using 3D CAD 
- Perform analyses ranging from classical textbook methods and 1D spreadsheet calculations to Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations to predict structural, thermal, and/or fluidic behavior of systems/components.
- Prepare drawings to manufacture prototypes or components of an experimental setup
- Document and communicate assumptions, inputs and proposed solutions to multidisciplinary teams for review
- Support validation of new designs and technologies through benchtop or larger-scale testing
- Prepare presentations and slides to communicate ideas and/or progress on projects
- Ability to work well in with Integrated Product Teams to create and verify novel design solutions that meet established program objectives and requirements (technical, cost, schedule) 

Required Qualifications



- Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited college or university
- 5+ years design and analysis experience. 
- Strong understanding of engineering principles and applying them to technical tasks
- Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems
- Skilled in mechanical design using 3D CAD Siemens NX or equivalent 
- Skilled with Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel and PowerPoint
- This role requires use of technical data subject to U.S. Government contract restrictions and this posting is only for U.S. Citizens. GE will require proof of status.

Desired Characteristics



- Master’s Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited college or university
- Skilled with Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and performing simulations in ANSYS for thermal-structural analysis 
- Experience high speed aerospace propulsion industry
- Understanding of compressible flow
- Knowledge of prototype manufacturing development processes including Additive Manufacturing (AM), and DFM, DFA and DFAM techniques
-  Knowledge of GD&T and application to engineering drawings
- Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker
-  Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance

The base pay range for this position is $95,000 - $159,400. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assist

The role focuses on developing robust, cost-effective pumping solutions that meet customer requirements. Key responsibilities include pump design and analysis, supporting root cause investigations, evaluating test and empirical data, validating design tools, and reconciling analytical results with test performance.

Strong communication skills are essential, as the engineer will work with both internal and external customers and must effectively communicate technical information to a variety of audiences.

Zwraca szczególną uwagę na nasze procesy, aby pomóc utrzymać wysokie standardy, a także wprowadza ulepszenia, aby podnieść je jeszcze wyżej.

Key job responsibilities



-  Modelowanie najlepszych praktyk w zakresie bezpiecznego użytkowania sprzętu i monitorowanie zespołów w celu zapewnienia, że wszyscy przestrzegają właściwych procesów
-  Śledzenie wydajności sprzętu poprzez kontrole wizualne, monitorowanie stanu technicznego i zadania związane z konserwacją zapobiegawczą oraz, w razie potrzeby, planowanie dodatkowych czynności serwisowych
-  Nadzorowanie techników na zmianie w celu wspierania ich rozwoju i pełnienie roli pierwszego punktu kontaktu dla inżynierów utrzymania ruchu i infrastruktury
-  Rozwiązywanie problemów związanych z urządzeniami w celu ograniczenia przestojów w pracy, umożliwiając jak najszybszą obsługę paczek
-  Udział w poszukiwaniu sposobów ciągłego usprawnienia systemów i standaryzacji procesów w całej sieci europejskiej

A day in the life

Osoba na tym stanowisku zarządza zespołem na swojej zmianie, upewniając się, że odpowiedni sprzęt jest dla każdego dostępny i że działa prawidłowo. Obejmuje to monitorowanie procesów w celu zapewnienia przestrzegania przepisów i zasad oraz zagwarantowanie, że przeprowadzana jest konserwacja zapobiegawcza w celu zwiększenia niezawodności sprzętu.

Biorąc pod uwagę wszystko, co obserwuje podczas swojej pracy, przedstawia sugestie dotyczące ulepszeń, aby nasze systemy były bardziej wydajne i produktywne, a następnie wdraża je w obrębie całej UE. Monitoruje również procesy za pomocą narzędzi takich jak Scada, aby zagwarantować ich wydajność, a także ściśle współpracuje ze swoim bezpośrednim przełożonym, pomagając w zadaniach administracyjnych.

Osoba na tym stanowisku pracuje w jednym z naszych centrów logistycznych w systemie zmianowym, który obejmuje niektóre weekendy oraz pracę nocną. W miarę rozwoju doświadczenia w tym ekscytującym segmencie firmy Amazon otrzyma dobre przygotowanie do awansu na wyższe stanowiska.

Minimalne wynagrodzenie zasadnicze dla tego stanowiska jest wskazane poniżej. Amazon zastrzega sobie możliwość zaproponowania wyższej wartości wynagrodzenia zasadniczego, w zależności od posiadanych umiejętności, kompetencji i doświadczenia kandydata. Amazon kieruje się zasadą całkowitego wynagrodzenia, w związku z czym oprócz wynagrodzenia zasadniczego mogą być przewidziane dodatkowe składniki wynagrodzenia, takie jak premia rekrutacyjna oraz możliwość uczestnictwa w programie akcji zastrzeżonych (RSU) prowadzonym niezależnie przez Amazon.com Inc. w USA. title: Inspektor Techniczny (M/K) / QA-QC Inspector / – współpraca B2B
text:
SGS jest światowym liderem w dziedzinie badań, inspekcji i certyfikacji. Posiadamy ponad 145 lat doświadczenia w dostarczaniu doskonałych usług – łączymy dokładność i precyzję, które charakteryzują szwajcarskie firmy, by pomagać organizacjom w osiąganiu najwyższych standardów jakości, zgodności i zrównoważonego rozwoju. 


Nasze hasło – when you need to be sure – to obietnica podkreślająca nasze przywiązanie do zaufania, rzetelności i niezawodności, które umożliwiają firmom rozwijanie się z pewnością siebie. SGS Polska rozbudowuje sieć inspektorów technicznych współpracujących w formule B2B przy realizacji projektów dla sektora przemysłowego, energetycznego i produkcyjnego. 


Zapraszamy do współpracy osoby posiadające doświadczenie w prowadzeniu inspekcji technicznych, kontroli jakości, odbiorów technicznych oraz inspekcji przedwysyłkowych wykonywanych u producentów, dostawców i na obiektach przemysłowych. 


Nie szukamy jednej osoby od wszystkiego. Chcemy nawiązać współpracę z ekspertami z różnych obszarów technicznych, których będziemy mogli angażować do projektów zgodnie z ich doświadczeniem, uprawnieniami, lokalizacją i dostępnością.

Nie wymagamy doświadczenia we wszystkich wymienionych obszarach. Wystarczy doświadczenie w jednej lub kilku specjalizacjach technicznych.

title: Mechanical Engineer
text:
Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today!

Job Description

Pump & Valve Engineering designs, analyzes, tests, and delivers advanced technologies for the next generation of reactor plant components. We are seeking a new team member to assist in flow control component and test hardware design, and perform fluid and/or structural evaluations, using a combination of first-principles engineering and finite element analysis. The evaluations performed by the selected candidate will quantify and improve the performance of both new and existing component technologies with the goal of maintaining the US Navy's technical edge.

In this role, the selected candidate will be empowered to enhance their design, analysis, and collaboration skills through challenging work assignments, mentoring, and in-house training programs. The design and analysis results generated in this role will directly impact important ongoing technology development efforts. Job responsibilities may include hydraulic design, modeling and analysis, test sponsorship, documenting the results of performance evaluations, methods development, and integration with various testing communities and other engineering disciplines.

Required Combination Of Knowledge And Skill

Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Doctorate degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering, science field; or Currently an Advanced Reactor Training Engineer, Refueling Engineer, or Field (RPCO) Engineer at the Company.

Preferred Skills



- Strong problem solving, teaming, and communication skills.
- Basic understanding of engineering mechanics, fluids, heat transfer, or flow control equipment (e.g., pumps, valves). 
- Prior experience in at least one of the following areas is preferred: equipment design using CAD tools (e.g. Creo, Solidworks), fluid dynamics modeling (e.g., CFX, Fluent, OpenFoam), thermal/structural FEA modeling (e.g., ABAQUS, ANSYS), or design for manufacture (including additive manufacturing).

Rattaché(e) au CTO, votre rôle sera de concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions basées sur l'Intelligence Artificielle (Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLM/IA Générative) et d'assurer leur intégration fluide et performante dans les produits de l'entreprise.
Vos responsabilités s'articulent autour de 4 piliers :

- 
Développement & Optimisation IA : Sélectionner, fine-tuner et concevoir les algorithmes et architectures IA adaptés aux besoins métier.
- 
Industrialisation & MLOps : Déployer les modèles en production, automatiser leur réentraînement et monitorer leurs performances.
- 
Intégration Applicative : Exposer les fonctionnalités IA via des APIs scalables pour les équipes Software.
- 
Veille & Innovation : Expérimenter en continu les dernières avancées (LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, vision/audio) pour créer de la valeur.

Concevoir et développer des architectures IA / ML applicatives (NLP, LLMs, Vision par ordinateur, systèmes de recommandation).

Sélectionner, adapter et fine-tuner des modèles open-source ou propriétaires (ex: Hugging Face, OpenAI, Mistral).
- 
Développer des architectures RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) et intégrer des bases de données vectorielles (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus).

Mettre en place des pipelines MLOps pour automatiser l'entraînement, la validation et le versioning des modèles et des données (MLflow, DVC).

Conteneuriser (Docker) et déployer les modèles sur des infrastructures Cloud scalables (GPUs/CPUs).
- 
Mettre en place le monitoring continu en production (dérive des données/data drift, dérive des performances, temps de réponse, coûts).

- 
Développer des APIs ultra-performantes et sécurisées (FastAPI, Python) pour exposer les modèles aux applications.
- 
Optimiser l'inférence des modèles pour réduire la latence et les coûts de calcul (ONNX, TensorRT, vLLM).
- 
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les Data Engineers (accès aux données) et les Développeurs Backend.




- 
Environnement de travail stimulant et collaboratif

Opportunités de développement professionnel

Culture d'entreprise axée sur l'innovation
- 
Participation à des projets variés et enrichissants

Possibilité d'évolution au sein de l'entreprise

- 
Formation : Bac+5 (École d'ingénieurs, Master IA / Data Science / Informatique).

IA Générative & Vector Databases : Expérience sur les modèles LLM, prompting/fine-tuning, architectures RAG et vector DBs (Qdrant, Pinecone, ChromaDB).

MLOps & Software Engineering : Maîtrise de Docker, des APIs (FastAPI), des pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI / GitHub Actions) et du suivi de modèles (MLflow, Weights & Biases).

🧠 Savoir-être (Soft Skills)

- 
Rigueur scientifique & Pragmatisme : Capacité à équilibrer l'état de l'art technologique et l'efficacité opérationnelle en production.
- 
Pédagogie & Communication : Capacité à expliquer le fonctionnement et les limites d'un modèle

title: AI Engineer

text:
Naszą misją jest przewodzenie transformacji przemysłowej poprzez promowanie innowacji i zrównoważonego rozwoju. Od optymalizacji centrów danych i przyspieszenia produkcji wodoru, po zrewolucjonizowanie systemów chłodniczych i HVAC — nasze rozwiązania termiczne dla infrastruktury krytycznej zwiększają możliwości przemysłu na całym świecie. Nasz globalny zespół, zjednoczony pod nazwą "One Kelvion", dostarcza innowacyjne rozwiązania, które napędzają sukces klientów i wspierają zrównoważoną przyszłość.

Razem, kształtujemy przyszłość

Twój zakres obowiązków:



- Nadzorowanie i wspieranie instalacji i uruchomienia wymienników ciepła Kelvion i powiązanych systemów u klientów. 
- Współpraca z zespołami instalacyjnymi i wykonawcami w celu zapewnienia prawidłowego montażu zgodnie z dokumentacją techniczną i normami bezpieczeństwa.

- Pracę w międzynarodowej firmie o ugruntowanej pozycji na rynku.

title: Sourcing & Procurement Data Analyst
text:
Department: Operations

Location: EMEA-Poland

Description

In this role, you will take ownership of collecting, cleaning, and analyzing a variety of procurement data that will provide our team vital insights to enhance sourcing strategies, improve supplier performance, and realize process efficiencies.

You will be part of a matrixed global team with peers based in San Jose – CA, Raleigh – NC, Rotkreuz – CH, Wroclaw – PL, Juarez – MX, and Ziyang – CN.

Role expectations



-  Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that track KPIs such as sourcing contributions, spend under management, supplier performance, procurement process SLAs, and policy compliance
-  Lead data cleansing, enrichment, and classification efforts to improve data quality and reporting accuracy
-  Partner with category managers to support sourcing initiatives with data-driven insights
-  Analyze procurement and sourcing data to identify cost-saving opportunities, supplier consolidation, and risk mitigation strategies
-  Assist in the development and execution of sourcing events (RFx, direct negotiations), including spend data collection and bid response analysis/scorecards
-  Participate in continuous improvement projects to enhance sourcing operations and procurement processes; identifying process inefficiencies and recommending solutions
-  Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards for MRP validation, applying planning assumptions and buffer logic
-  Execute and monitor MRP processes in SAP APO/ECC, including BOM management, inventory analysis, and demand-supply alignment
-  Prepare and upload forecasts for long-term planning, ensuring accurate data integration and adjustments across regions
-  Collaborate with procurement and sourcing teams to align purchase orders, resolve supply issues, and communicate planning updates

What We're Looking For



-  B.A./B.S. or equivalent experience
-  3-5 years of relevant experience in procurement, supply chain, or a similar data-driven role within finance
-  Able to interpret rough requirements/goals & effectively translate complex data into clear, insightful findings
-  Strong attention to detail; ability to identity inaccuracies & discrepancies
-  Familiarity with SQL or other database languages & PowerBI
-  Advanced Excel for forecast templates, data validation, and scenario analysis
-  Strong understanding of MRP principles, demand-supply planning, and inventory optimization
-  Ability to navigate through a matrixed organization & collaborate in a cross-regional team

title: HVDC Commissioning Engineer (f/m/d)
text:
We welcome applications from candidates across Poland, as this role is primarily based on international project assignments and not tied to a specific local office location.

A Snapshot of Your Day

In this role, you will ensure the seamless and timely commissioning of HVDC systems on site, while executing and documenting advanced testing activities for Control & Protection hardware and software. You will also prepare test procedures, coordinate factory and workshop tests with suppliers, and support quality, risk, and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.

How You’ll Make An Impact



- Ensure technically flawless and timely commissioning of HVDC systems on site, including testing of HV primary components and associated secondary systems.
- Perform integration and functional testing of HVDC control technology (Control & Protection hardware and software) in our test center in Germany.
- Execute and document Functional Performance Tests (FPT), Dynamic Performance Tests (DPT) of our C&P Hardware and Software including Customer Acceptance Tests.
- Develop and prepare detailed testing procedures and test programs for the C&P Hardware, including the necessary verification documentation.
- Plan, coordinate, and evaluate workshop tests (Factory Acceptance Tests) at sub-supplier facilities.
- Support Commissioning Management in quality, risk, and claim management activities, and actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives (e.g., Lean, reviews, lessons learned).


What You Bring



- Completed studies in electrical engineering, energy technology or comparable education / qualification; ideally combined with practical experience in electrical engineering and commissioning of electrical power stations.
- Solid knowledge in one or more of the following areas: project planning and testing via MATLAB/SIMULINK, Siemens SIMATIC TDC/S7, CFC, grid protection systems / protection relays & BCUs (DIGSI / SIPROTEC V4/5)
- Knowledge or experience in the field of HVDC systems, particularly in High Voltage Transmission Technology, Control, Measurement, Protection, and Communication Systems
- Understanding of Current- and Voltage Measuring devices and other primary equipment as well as network protection, C&P systems and other secondary systems
- Fluency in English, additional languages are a plus
- Willingness for worldwide business trips and mainly long-term assignments on construction sites in Germany and abroad, as well as optional assignments on offshore platforms


About The Team

Our Grid Technologies division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
